schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: A Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India to supplement financial needs of all landholding farmers families in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Direct financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of beneficiary farmers in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.
nonFinancial: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) linkage
Direct DBT transfers
SMS alerts for installment credit

specialConditions: Must possess cultivable landholding in own or family name
Institutional landholders and high-income tax payees are excluded

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Mandatory identity proof linked with mobile number

requiredDocuments.name: Land Ownership Records (RoR / Khasra-Khatauni)
requiredDocuments.description: Updated land record showing ownership of cultivable land

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Account Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Active bank account linked with Aadhaar for DBT

applicationProcedure: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and click on "Farmers Corner".
Select "New Farmer Registration" and enter Aadhaar number with captcha.
Fill in land record details, bank IFSC, and personal demographic information.
Submit the application and download the registration receipt for tracking.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description: The world's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme, providing a health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

benefits.description: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
nonFinancial: Covers pre-existing diseases from day one
Includes 3 days pre and 15 days post hospitalization
No restriction on family size or age

specialConditions: Households identified under SECC 2011 deprivation criteria (D1 to D7) or active NFSA ration card holders
Senior citizens aged 70+ are now covered under Ayushman Vay Vandana expansion

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Biometric verified identity card

requiredDocuments.name: Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / Priority Household)
requiredDocuments.description: Family membership and economic category verification

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Certified annual household income below threshold

applicationProcedure: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in or visit the nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir / CSC center.
Authenticate family members using Aadhaar e-KYC.
Generate the digital Ayushman Card / Golden Card instantly online or at hospital help desk.
Present the card at any empaneled hospital for cashless treatment.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-Urban & Gramin)
schemes.description: A flagship initiative to provide all-weather pucca housing with basic amenities (water, sanitation, electricity, LPG) to all eligible urban and rural homeless or dilapidated kutcha house dwellers.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefits.description: Up to ₹2.67 lakh interest subsidy on home loans under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) or direct financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh to ₹1.30 lakh in rural areas for house construction.
benefits.frequency: One-time loan subsidy or installment grant
nonFinancial: Toilet construction support via Swachh Bharat
Free electricity connection via Saubhagya
LPG gas via Ujjwala

specialConditions: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Female ownership or co-ownership of house is mandatory for EWS/LIG categories

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and deduplication

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: To categorize under EWS (<=₹3L) or LIG (₹3L-₹6L)

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Land/Plot or Rent Agreement
requiredDocuments.description: Valid land title or urban residency proof

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Statement (Past 6 Months)
requiredDocuments.description: Active account for DBT disbursement

applicationProcedure: Visit pmaymis.gov.in (for Urban) or pmayg.nic.in (for Gramin).
Select "Citizen Assessment" and choose "Apply Online".
Authenticate with Aadhaar and enter personal, economic, and present residential details.
Submit the declaration and track assessment through Application Assessment ID.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.description: A special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors to restart their livelihoods adversely affected during economic distress.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefits.description: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and up to ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment and digital transaction cashback up to ₹1,200/year.
nonFinancial: 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account
Digital cashback up to ₹100/month
Credit score building without collateral

specialConditions: Vendors engaged in vending in urban areas possessing Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)
Or vendors possessing Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by ULB/Town Vending Committee

requiredDocuments.name: Certificate of Vending / Vending ID Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of street vending issued by Municipal Authority

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Identity verification linked with mobile

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
requiredDocuments.description: Account for loan disbursement

applicationProcedure: Access pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or download the PM SVANidhi mobile app.
Click "Apply for Loan" and verify using mobile number with OTP.
Enter Vending Card / LoR details and choose preferred Lending Institution (Bank/NBFC/MFI).
Upload necessary documents and submit application for sanction within 7 days.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to provide financial support to SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing post-secondary / post-matriculation courses in recognized institutions to complete their education.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

benefits.description: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable compulsory academic tuition fees and monthly academic maintenance allowance ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 per annum depending on study level and hosteller/day-scholar status.
nonFinancial: Disability allowance of ₹2,000/year for differently-abled scholars
Book grant support for professional engineering and medical degrees

specialConditions: Must be enrolled in a recognized Class 11, 12, ITI, Polytechnic, UG, PG, or Ph.D. program
Should not be drawing any other Centrally funded scholarship concurrently

requiredDocuments.name: Caste / Community Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Certified SC/ST/OBC certificate by competent revenue officer

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of annual family income below ₹2.5 Lakh

requiredDocuments.name: Previous Academic Marksheet
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of passing 10th/12th/previous exam with minimum qualifying marks

requiredDocuments.name: Fee Receipt & Bonafide Student Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Admission proof issued by the current recognized educational institution

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Aadhaar seeded bank account for DBT payment

applicationProcedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with One Time Registration (OTR).
Fill in applicant details, academic institute selection, and course of study.
Upload caste, income, fee receipt, and marksheet.
Submit the application; college institute nodal officer validates before state approval.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Provides refinanced institutional credit up to ₹10 lakh (extended up to ₹20 lakh under Mudra 2.0) to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises for income-generating manufacturing, trading, and service activities.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Loans under three tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000), and Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000) with zero processing charges for Shishu loans and no collateral required.
nonFinancial: Mudra Debit Card for flexible working capital withdrawal
No collateral requirement
Low competitive bank interest rates

specialConditions: Non-corporate small business segment (proprietorship, partnership firms, small manufacturing units)
Should have a viable business proposal without any existing bank loan default history

requiredDocuments.name: Business Plan / Project Report
requiredDocuments.description: Brief overview of proposed enterprise, machinery, and projected earnings

requiredDocuments.name: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
requiredDocuments.description: Government verified ID

requiredDocuments.name: Address Proof of Business & Residence
requiredDocuments.description: Electricity bill, lease deed, or shop establishment certificate

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Statement (Last 12 Months)
requiredDocuments.description: Current or savings account statement

applicationProcedure: Visit the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or walk into any commercial bank, RRB, or MFI.
Select loan category: Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun depending on fund requirement.
Submit the loan application form with business profile and quotation of machinery/goods.
Bank sanctions and disburses loan amount with Mudra RuPay card.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
schemes.description: A government-backed small savings scheme designed specifically for parents of girl children to build a dedicated financial fund for their higher education and marriage expenses with sovereign safety.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

benefits.description: Attractive sovereign guaranteed annual interest rate (currently 8.2% per annum, compounded annually) with complete triple tax exemption (EEE) under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act.
nonFinancial: 50% partial withdrawal allowed for girl's higher education after age 18
Account matures at 21 years from date of opening
Exempt-Exempt-Exempt tax status

specialConditions: Account must be opened by biological or legal guardian in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age
Maximum of two accounts permitted per family (triplets/twins exception applies)

requiredDocuments.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
requiredDocuments.description: Official proof of date of birth and legal parentage

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of Parent / Guardian
requiredDocuments.description: Guardian identity and address verification

requiredDocuments.name: PAN Card of Guardian
requiredDocuments.description: Tax identity verification

requiredDocuments.name: Initial Deposit (Min ₹250)
requiredDocuments.description: Cash / Cheque / DD for opening account

applicationProcedure: Obtain Form 1 from any Post Office or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, BoB, etc.).
Attach girl child's birth certificate and guardian KYC documents.
Deposit initial opening amount (minimum ₹250).
Receive the physical SSY passbook containing account details.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: A universal social security pension scheme administered by PFRDA targeted particularly at workers in the unorganized sector to guarantee old age income security after retirement at age 60.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 per month upon reaching 60 years of age, continuing to spouse after death and returning accumulated corpus to nominee.
nonFinancial: Tax benefits under Section 80CCD(1B)
Spouse pension continuity
Nominee gets complete pension corpus upon spouse demise

specialConditions: Must possess a savings bank account with auto-debit facility
Should not be an income tax payer under existing tax laws

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Primary KYC identification for subscriber

requiredDocuments.name: Savings Bank Account Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Account with auto-debit mandate setup

requiredDocuments.name: Nominee Aadhaar Details
requiredDocuments.description: Verification of nominee for corpus payout

applicationProcedure: Approach your bank branch or use Internet Banking / mobile banking app.
Fill the APY registration form with chosen monthly pension slab (₹1,000 - ₹5,000).
Authorize auto-debit of the fixed monthly premium based on your entry age.
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) confirmation SMS.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC, ST and Women Entrepreneurs
schemes.description: Promotes entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Women by facilitating bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Composite bank loan (including term loan and working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore covering up to 85% of project cost with margin money support and handholding assistance.
nonFinancial: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Stand-Up India (CGSUI)
Pre-loan training and mentoring via SIDBI
Convergence with central and state subsidy schemes

specialConditions: Borrower must be either an SC, ST, or Woman entrepreneur
In non-individual enterprises, at least 51% of shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman
Must be for a first-time greenfield commercial venture

requiredDocuments.name: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST applicants)
requiredDocuments.description: Government verified certificate

requiredDocuments.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
requiredDocuments.description: Techno-economic feasibility report and financial projections
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Chartered Engineer / CA / SIDBI Handholding Agency

requiredDocuments.name: KYC Documents (Aadhaar & PAN)
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and tax identity of promoters

requiredDocuments.name: Pollution & Municipal Clearance / Land Lease
requiredDocuments.description: Site possession and regulatory clearances

applicationProcedure: Register on standupmitra.in as a "Trainee" (need handholding) or "Ready Borrower".
Select your target scheduled commercial bank branch.
Submit the Detailed Project Report along with loan application.
Track sanction status and attend interview with bank loan committee.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
schemes.description: A social welfare program providing deposit-free LPG connections to poor adult women from low-income households to safeguard their health from toxic emissions of biomass cooking fuel.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

benefits.description: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free first cylinder refill (14.2 kg) and free LPG hotplate (gas stove) along with ongoing targeted DBT subsidy of ₹300 per refill up to 12 refills/year.
nonFinancial: Complete freedom from hazardous smoke
Safety hose and regulator provided free of cost
Doorstep cylinder delivery

specialConditions: Applicant must be an adult female belonging to a poor household
No other LPG connection must exist in the household under any OMC (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL)

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant Woman
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and residence verification

requiredDocuments.name: Ration Card / Family Composition Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Listing names of family members living in household

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar of all adult family members
requiredDocuments.description: Deduplication across oil marketing companies

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded)
requiredDocuments.description: Account for LPG refill DBT subsidy

applicationProcedure: Visit pmuy.gov.in and click "Apply for New Ujjwala 2.0 Connection".
Select preferred LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).
Fill in applicant details, submit self-declaration of family composition.
Distributor inspects premise and installs gas connection free of charge.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
schemes.description: Skill certification scheme aimed at enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that helps them secure a better livelihood through Short Term Training (STT), Special Projects, and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL).
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

benefits.description: 100% free government-sponsored certified skill training in futuristic sectors (AI, Robotics, Solar Energy, Drone Technology, Healthcare), NSQF certification, and direct post-placement financial stipend.
nonFinancial: National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) recognized diploma
Placement support and job melas
Accidental insurance during training

specialConditions: College students or unemployed youth seeking technical skills
Candidate should possess basic literacy or required minimum education according to Job Role QP

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Mandatory identity proof for biometric attendance

requiredDocuments.name: Educational Qualification Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of highest completed schooling/degree

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Account Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: For direct transfer of candidate stipend

applicationProcedure: Visit skillindiadigital.gov.in and register using mobile OTP.
Explore available skill courses in your district and nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK).
Enroll in batch, complete classroom and hands-on practical training.
Take third-party sector skill council assessment and receive digital NSQF certificate.

schemes.name: ADIP Scheme - Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances
schemes.description: Provides durable, modern, and scientifically manufactured standard aids and assistive devices (motorized tricycles, smart hearing aids, braille kits, prosthetics) to persons with disabilities to enhance their physical, social, and economic rehabilitation.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

benefits.description: 100% free aids and assistive devices (e.g. motorized tricycles worth ₹42,000, digital hearing aids, artificial limbs) for individuals with monthly income up to ₹22,500; 50% subsidy for income between ₹22,501 to ₹30,000.
benefits.frequency: Free assistive appliances once every 3 years
nonFinancial: Free clinical fitting and audiometry tests
Post-fitting maintenance warranty
Specialized braille laptops and screen reader kits

specialConditions: Must possess a certified benchmark disability of 40% or more (UDID Card)
Should not have received assistance for the same appliance from government during the last 3 years

requiredDocuments.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID Card) / Disability Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of 40% or higher benchmark disability

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Certified annual household income below threshold

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Identity verification

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph showing disability
requiredDocuments.description: Physical assessment verification

applicationProcedure: Register on the ALIMCO portal (alimco.in) or Swavlamban portal (swavlambancard.gov.in).
Upload UDID card, income certificate, and specific required assistive device.
Attend the district ADIP assessment camp organized by ALIMCO / District Social Welfare Office.
Receive device during official distribution camp with personalized fitting.

schemes.name: PM - Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.description: A transformative rooftop solar scheme launched by the Government of India aiming to light up 1 crore households by providing up to 300 units of free electricity every month with direct capital subsidies.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

benefits.description: Capital subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW and higher rooftop solar systems, credited straight to the beneficiary bank account within 30 days of net-meter inspection.
benefits.frequency: One-time Capital Subsidy + 300 monthly free units
nonFinancial: Net metering integration with state DISCOM
Zero recurring electricity bill for consumption up to 300 units/month
Surplus solar power purchase back by DISCOM at approved feed-in tariff
Direct collateral-free bank loans at concessional interest rate of ~7%

specialConditions: Must possess a suitable rooftop with adequate solar access on owned or family residential premise
Must have an active residential electricity connection in beneficiary or family member's name with local DISCOM
Should not have availed rooftop solar subsidy under any other central or state government program for the same address

requiredDocuments.name: Electricity Bill (Latest 2 Months)
requiredDocuments.description: Showing active consumer account number (CA number) and sanctioned domestic load

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and residence verification linked with mobile number

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
requiredDocuments.description: Aadhaar-seeded bank account for direct DBT subsidy crediting

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Roof / Property Ownership
requiredDocuments.description: Municipal house tax receipt, sale deed, or property tax assessment

applicationProcedure: Register on the National Rooftop Solar Portal (pmsuryaghar.gov.in) with State, DISCOM name, and Consumer Account Number.
Submit online application choosing system capacity (1 kW, 2 kW, or 3 kW+) and select a DISCOM-registered empaneled vendor.
Vendor installs the rooftop solar plant and DISCOM installs bidirectional net meter.
DISCOM issues commissioning certificate on the portal and DBT subsidy is disbursed directly to your bank account within 30 days.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma - Central Sector Scheme for Traditional Artisans and Craftspeople
schemes.description: Provides end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspersons engaged in 18 trades (carpentry, blacksmithing, pottery, goldsmithing, tailoring, cobbling, sculpture, boat building, etc.) with identity recognition, skill upgrading, modern toolkits, collateral-free credit, and digital transaction incentives.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

benefits.description: Formal recognition through PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 digital e-voucher for modern toolkits, and collateral-free enterprise loan up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate.
nonFinancial: Formal PM Vishwakarma digital identity card
National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) recognized skill certification
₹1 per digital transaction incentive up to 100 transactions per month
Marketing support and onboarding on Government e-Marketplace (GeM)

specialConditions: Must be actively practicing one of the 18 notified family-based traditional trades using hands and tools
Only one member per family (husband, wife, and unmarried children) is eligible for benefits under the scheme
Should not have availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra during the past 5 years

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Biometric identity linked with active mobile number

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Account Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Active bank account for stipend and toolkit voucher crediting

requiredDocuments.name: Ration Card / Family Composition Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Verification of single family beneficiary rule

requiredDocuments.name: Trade Self-Declaration
requiredDocuments.description: Verification of traditional craftsmanship during CSC biometric registration

applicationProcedure: Visit any Common Services Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and bank details for biometric e-KYC.
Select your specific traditional trade out of the 18 eligible categories and submit registration.
Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body conducts 3-tier field verification and approves the applicant.
Attend 5-day basic skill training, receive ₹15,000 tool voucher, and apply for 1st tranche loan of ₹1,00,000.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.description: A flagship initiative under Atmanirbhar Bharat to drive the Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development of the fisheries sector in India, boosting fish production, farmer incomes, and post-harvest infrastructure.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

benefits.description: Financial subsidy of 40% for General Category and 60% for SC, ST, and Women beneficiaries on capital costs of pond construction, biofloc units, recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS), motorized fishing craft, and cold storage units.
nonFinancial: Group accident insurance coverage of ₹5,00,000 for active fishers
Free technical training and extension services at Central Fisheries Research Institutes
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) interest subvention for working capital inputs
Assistance for live fish vending kiosks and three-wheeler insulated vehicles

specialConditions: Beneficiary must be an active fisher, fish farmer, fish worker, SHG, or fishery cooperative
Must possess or lease suitable land/waterbody for inland aquaculture, or hold valid marine fishing license

requiredDocuments.name: Fisherfolk ID Card / Vessel Registration Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of involvement in fishing or aquaculture

requiredDocuments.name: Land / Water Body Lease or Ownership Documents
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of minimum water surface area or pond lease for 7+ years

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and tax verification

requiredDocuments.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR) / Cost Estimate
requiredDocuments.description: Technical feasibility and cost schedule

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT subsidy release

applicationProcedure: Access the PMMSY online portal (pmmsy.dof.gov.in) or visit District Fisheries Office.
Submit Detailed Project Proposal along with land/water lease documents and beneficiary details.
District Level Committee (DLC) inspects and approves the proposal.
Execute project and claim subsidy tranches directly through DBT into linked bank account.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.description: A direct benefit transfer (DBT) scheme implemented under Mission Shakti to provide partial cash compensation for wage loss to pregnant women and lactating mothers so that the woman can take adequate rest before and after delivery.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

benefits.description: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 for first living child in two installments (₹3,000 upon early pregnancy registration & ANC; ₹2,000 upon child birth registration & first cycle vaccination), plus ₹6,000 in a single installment for the birth of a second girl child.
nonFinancial: Free Antenatal Care (ANC) checkups and maternal health tracking
Institutional delivery incentives under Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
Free childhood immunization covering BCG, OPV, DPT, and Hepatitis B
Nutrition counseling via local Anganwadi Centres

specialConditions: Applicant must be a pregnant woman or lactating mother aged 19 years or older
Women in regular employment with Central or State Government or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) are not eligible
Applicable for socially and economically disadvantaged sections (SC/ST, Divyangjan, EWS, Ayushman Bharat beneficiaries, or annual income < ₹8 Lakh)

requiredDocuments.name: Mother & Child Protection (MCP) Card
requiredDocuments.description: Issued during first antenatal clinic registration

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of Mother
requiredDocuments.description: Mandatory biometric identity proof

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of Husband / Spouse
requiredDocuments.description: Family identity verification

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Account Passbook of Mother
requiredDocuments.description: Single savings bank account in mother's name linked with Aadhaar

requiredDocuments.name: Child Birth Registration Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Required for claiming second installment

applicationProcedure: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or accredited healthcare facility within 570 days of Last Menstrual Period (LMP).
Or register online on the PMMVY Citizen Portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) using Aadhaar-linked mobile OTP.
Submit ANC checkup verification from MCP card to receive first tranche of ₹3,000.
Submit child birth registration certificate and first immunization record to receive final installment.

schemes.name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative - Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana (DAY-NRLM)
schemes.description: A national mission to empower 3 crore rural women belonging to Self Help Groups (SHGs) to earn a sustainable minimum income of ₹1,00,000 (one lakh rupees) per year through diverse micro-enterprises, value chain aggregation, and emerging technology adoption.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

benefits.description: Access to collateral-free community enterprise loans up to ₹10,00,000 at low interest rates, specialized technical training in Drone piloting (Namo Drone Didi), solar panel assembly, LED bulb production, mushroom farming, and guaranteed market linkages.
benefits.frequency: Micro-enterprise credit + specialized tech equipment grant
nonFinancial: Certified Drone Pilot Training by DGCA authorized institutes for selected SHG women
Brand packaging and marketing on Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and Saras Fairs
Financial literacy and digital bookkeeping app access
Mentorship by master trainers and Krishi Sakhis

specialConditions: Must be an active rural woman member of a Self Help Group (SHG) registered under DAY-NRLM for at least 1 year
Must actively participate in regular weekly SHG meetings and internal thrift savings
Should prepare an individual livelihood plan (Livelihood Micro-Plan) approved by Village Organization (VO)

requiredDocuments.name: SHG Membership Passbook / NRLM Member ID
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of active membership in recognized SHG
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Village Organization / Block Mission Management Unit

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and address verification

requiredDocuments.name: Individual Bank Savings Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Bank account linked with Aadhaar for DBT

requiredDocuments.name: Gram Panchayat / VO Recommendation Resolution
requiredDocuments.description: Resolution passed by SHG supporting the micro-enterprise loan

applicationProcedure: Discuss your proposed livelihood activity (e.g. food processing, drone servicing, poultry, tailoring) in weekly SHG meeting.
Village Organization (VO) and Community Resource Persons (CRPs) assist in preparing the micro-investment business plan.
Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) sanctions loan from Community Investment Fund (CIF) or facilitates Bank Credit Linkage.
Undergo free specialized enterprise and technical training at Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI).

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme designed to award merit scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop-out after Class VIII and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage (Class IX to XII).
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

benefits.description: Direct scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) credited quarterly directly into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account for 4 consecutive years from Class IX to Class XII upon maintaining satisfactory academic record.
nonFinancial: Direct integration with National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Exemption from secondary school tuition in multiple states
Academic mentoring and career guidance from State Education Departments
Prepares students for prestigious NTSE and national competitive entrance examinations

specialConditions: Candidate must be studying as a regular student in Class VIII in a State Government, Local Body, or Government-aided school
Must have secured minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Class VII annual examination
Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, and residential schools where boarding & lodging is provided are not eligible
Must clear the State-level NMMS Examination consisting of Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT)

requiredDocuments.name: Class VII Marksheet / Report Card
requiredDocuments.description: Verification of 55%+ aggregate marks

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Parental annual family income not exceeding ₹3,50,000

requiredDocuments.name: Caste / Disability Certificate (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.description: For quota and concession validation

requiredDocuments.name: Student Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook
requiredDocuments.description: Savings bank account in student's name linked with Aadhaar

requiredDocuments.name: Bonafide School Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Certifying enrollment as regular student in Class VIII

applicationProcedure: Register for the State-level NMMS Examination conducted by State SCERT / Education Board.
Appear in the selection test (MAT - 90 questions, SAT - 90 questions).
Once selected in state merit quota, register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR.
School validates enrollment online and DBT disbursement of ₹12,000/year begins.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers to ensure monthly income security and dignity during old age, with equal 50% matching monthly contribution deposited by the Central Government.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment

benefits.description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 per month (₹36,000 per year) after attaining 60 years of age, 50% family pension continuation to spouse upon subscriber death, and return of corpus if both pass away.
nonFinancial: Equal 50% matching contribution paid directly by Central Government
Automatic auto-debit facility from savings bank account
Permanent PM-SYM Pension Card with unique Pension Account Number
Family pension protection for spouse

specialConditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker with monthly income of ₹15,000 or below (annual income <= ₹1,80,000)
Should not be an income tax payee and not covered under formal social security schemes like EPFO, ESIC, or NPS (Govt funded)

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.description: Identity verification

requiredDocuments.name: Savings Bank Account Passbook / Jan Dhan Account Details
requiredDocuments.description: Bank account with active mobile number for auto-debit setup

requiredDocuments.name: e-Shram Card (Optional but recommended)
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of unorganized worker registration

applicationProcedure: Visit nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and bank passbook/IFSC.
VLE calculates monthly contribution (₹55 at age 18 to ₹200 at age 40) based on entry age.
First month contribution paid in cash; sign auto-debit mandate form.
Instantly receive unique PM-SYM Pension Card with Permanent Retirement Pension Number.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.description: Enables micro and small enterprises (MSEs) to access collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹500 Lakh (₹5 Crore) by providing sovereign-backed guarantee coverage up to 85% of sanctioned loan facility.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

benefits.description: Credit guarantee coverage on term loans and composite working capital up to ₹5 Crore without third-party guarantee or tangible collateral security, with 85% guarantee coverage for loans up to ₹5 Lakh and women/SC/ST/NER enterprises.
nonFinancial: Zero collateral or physical property mortgage required
Faster loan processing at scheduled commercial banks and NBFCs
Annual guarantee fee concession for women-led and aspirational district MSEs
Direct refinancing link through SIDBI

specialConditions: Must be a new or existing Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) with valid Udyam Registration
Engaged in manufacturing, trading, or service sector activities (excluding agricultural direct farming and educational institutions)
Viable project proposal evaluated by Member Lending Institution (MLI) bank

requiredDocuments.name: Udyam Registration Certificate (URC)
requiredDocuments.description: Formal proof of MSME registration

requiredDocuments.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
requiredDocuments.description: Feasibility report, machinery quote, cash flow projections, and business model

requiredDocuments.name: KYC of Promoters / Partners (Aadhaar, PAN)
requiredDocuments.description: Legal identity of business owners

requiredDocuments.name: Financial Statements & ITR (Past 2-3 Years if existing)
requiredDocuments.description: Audited balance sheets and profit & loss statements

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Business Premises / Industrial Lease
requiredDocuments.description: Electricity connection or lease agreement of factory/shop

applicationProcedure: Prepare business proposal and obtain Udyam Registration on udyamregistration.gov.in.
Apply at any Member Lending Institution (All Public Sector Banks, Private Banks, RRBs, or SIDBI).
Lending bank evaluates business viability and sanctions collateral-free credit under CGTMSE cover.
Bank applies directly to CGTMSE portal for guarantee sanction; loan disbursed to enterprise.

applications.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
applications.notes: Submitted online via CSC Kendra Varanasi. Aadhaar e-KYC completed successfully.

applications.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applications.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
applications.notes: Need to get latest family ration card updated at Tehsildar office.

scheme.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-Urban & Gramin)
scheme.description: A flagship initiative to provide all-weather pucca housing with basic amenities (water, sanitation, electricity, LPG) to all eligible urban and rural homeless or dilapidated kutcha house dwellers.
scheme.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

benefits.description: Up to ₹2.67 lakh interest subsidy on home loans under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) or direct financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh to ₹1.30 lakh in rural areas for house construction.
benefits.frequency: One-time loan subsidy or installment grant
nonFinancial: Toilet construction support via Swachh Bharat
Free electricity connection via Saubhagya
LPG gas via Ujjwala

specialConditions: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Female ownership or co-ownership of house is mandatory for EWS/LIG categories

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
requiredDocuments.description: Identity and deduplication

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.description: To categorize under EWS (<=₹3L) or LIG (₹3L-₹6L)

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Land/Plot or Rent Agreement
requiredDocuments.description: Valid land title or urban residency proof

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Statement (Past 6 Months)
requiredDocuments.description: Active account for DBT disbursement

applicationProcedure: Visit pmaymis.gov.in (for Urban) or pmayg.nic.in (for Gramin).
Select "Citizen Assessment" and choose "Apply Online".
Authenticate with Aadhaar and enter personal, economic, and present residential details.
Submit the declaration and track assessment through Application Assessment ID.
